stage0098b_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$リーロン$$!
　Load every weapon we've got onto my Gunmen!」

stage0098b_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「We'll punch through the enemy with firepower...!
　And we'll destroy that thing they call
　the Death Spiral Machine!」

stage0098b_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$キタン$$
「Wait, $$ヨーコ$$!
　That one's my job!」

stage0098b_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$キタン$$
「$$リーロン$$!
　Whose machine is the toughest of all of us!」

stage0098b_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$リーロン$$
「...it's your $$スペースキングキタン$$.」

stage0098b_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$キタン$$
「That's how it is.
　Sorry, but leave this one to me.」

stage0098b_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$キタン$$
「Load $$グレンラガン$$'s spare drill onto King Kittan!
　I'll punch through anyone who gets in my way!」

stage0098b_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ギミー$$
「That's not fair, going off looking for a place to die like that...
　I can't do something like that...!」

stage0098b_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$キタン$$
「Are you stupid!?
　Where is there a single person who isn't afraid to die!」

stage0098b_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$キタン$$
「But hey... it can't be helped...!
　This is all I'm good for...!
　We do this because we want to...!」

stage0098b_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$キタン$$
「That's exactly why, being scared, all we can do is push forward!」

stage0098b_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$キタン$$
「I'll tell you this much.
　It's because I have friends like you that I can go reckless.
　It's because you're behind me that I can keep moving forward.」

stage0098b_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$キタン$$
「If $$シモン$$'s pulling from above,
　and I'm the one pushing up from below,
　that's because you're the ones pushing my back.」

stage0098b_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$キタン$$
「...I'm looking forward to seeing how far you all can go!」

stage0098b_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$キタン$$
「...Sorry, this is my selfishness too.」

stage0098b_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「...Idiot...
　Don't apologize at a time like this...」

stage0098b_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「This operation's chance of success was zero percent...
　But it seems armchair calculations are wasted on you lot.」

stage0098b_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「With the Death Spiral Machine destroyed,
　that universe has become filled with Spiral energy.」

stage0098b_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「And the will of the Spiral warriors left behind there
　will guide us to the true Sealed Universe
　where the $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$ dwells.」

stage0098b_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Is that where he is, beyond this light...!?」

stage0098b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「What awaits there is the final battle.」

stage0098b_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Unfortunately, this is as far as it goes for you... Man of the Spiral.」

stage0098b_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Sacrificing your own comrades to open a path forward...
　Never once reflecting on destruction wrought for survival...
　That is the karma of the Spiral race.」

stage0098b_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Spiral power is the force that binds the universe and life together...
　A single life can draw out the power of an infinite universe...」

stage0098b_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「But life cannot control that power.
　That is the truth of this universe.」

stage0098b_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Spiral power runs out of control, and the energy that bursts from the body
　becomes a single galaxy.」

stage0098b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Once the runaway of Spiral power begins, in an instant,
　as many galaxies as there are lives are born into the universe.」

stage0098b_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「The excess galaxies devour each other,
　become black holes, and the universe returns to nothing...
　That is the Spiral Nemesis.」

stage0098b_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「A runaway called evolution
　destroys the universe in an instant.」

stage0098b_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Fearing that, there exists one who will not allow mankind to evolve.
　The instant that one senses evolution moving toward true Evolution,
　it moves to destroy everything in that universe.」

stage0098b_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「That one is life's ultimate enemy...
　In other words, the Primal Catastrophe...」

stage0098b_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「People of the Spiral race.
　Perish, before you draw the wrath of the gods.」

stage0098b_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「That is the one and only absolute means of protecting this universe.」

stage0098b_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「What are you doing, $$シモン$$!
　Don't let his words deceive you!」

stage0098b_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「A life without Spiral power... Beastman.
　You couldn't possibly understand.」

stage0098b_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Right now, everyone but you has had their souls seized
　by the primal fear carved into their genes.」

stage0098b_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「I will give you all a fate.」

stage0098b_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「The Multiversal Labyrinth...
　Spend your life, shut away, for all eternity,
　in a hell of infinite possibility.」

stage0098b_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「That's right.
　The same mercy that one showed you.」

stage0098b_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I will never forget your heroic form.」

stage0098b_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And the 1000 Z-Chips born from the final
　radiance of your life...
　surely, one day, these will save the world.」

stage0098b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But everyone except me
　may end up forgetting about you...」

stage0098b_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is the eternity created by the $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$,
　the Multiversal Labyrinth.」

stage0098b_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...This is quite bad, isn't it.
　This is hardly the time to celebrate an ace pilot.」

stage0098b_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The Multiversal Labyrinth...
　I'm afraid this may be the end.」

stage0098b_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If that happens,
　will all the Z-Chips I've saved up
　end up going to waste too...」

stage0098b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... if it happens, it happens!
　So, even if I become the last one left,
　I'll stay fired up... business, business!!」
